Ingrid M.: running through the onboarding sample app and noticed trace ids aren't showing up in logs
Jay K.: hm what do you mean? are you seeing OTEL_TRACEID env var set?
Ingrid M.: yeah set OTEL_TRACEPARENT and OTEL_TRACEID in .env, but logs still show null req_id
Maria S.: we only pick up traceparent when using the SDK helper. sample app uses process.env directly? that's the mismatch
Ingrid M.: sample app sets REDWOOD_REQ_ID from middleware but our otel hook looks for X-Request-Id header or traceparent
Jay K.: ohhh, so env var vs header parity
sam-devex-bot: FYI deploy v0.3.1 rolled: telemetry-hooks v2.4.0 -> v2.5.0
Ingrid M.: also noticed when I toggle LOG_LEVEL=debug, sensitive headers (Authorization) get printed in a few log lines from retry logic
Maria S.: that's bad. we should redact auth headers at the logger sink regardless of level
Jay K.: can you paste the few lines? might be the retry middleware logs `options` object
Ingrid M.: sure
```
DEBUG [retry] attempt=1 url=/api/generate options={ headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer sk-REDACT_ME', 'X-Request-Id': 'r-123' } }
```
Maria S.: that string 'Bearer sk-REDACT_ME' looks pre-redacted but from my repro it was the real token
Ingrid M.: in local I saw full token until I flipped REDACTION_STRATEGY=auto
Jay K.: weird, our otel hook registers before the redaction plugin so traces capture sensitive headers and then log sink runs later
Maria S.: probable ordering bug between our OpenTelemetry http instrumentation hook and the redaction transform. hooks are registered in sampleapp bootstrap
Ingrid M.: on top of that, retries will clone options and may reattach headers so redaction missed clone path
Jay K.: ok action items: (1) update sample app to call redaction.register() before otel.init(); (2) add redaction in serialize/clone paths in retry middleware; (3) add test that runs with LOG_LEVEL=debug to catch leak
Maria S.: I'll open a tiny PR to swap order and add unit
sam-devex-bot: created PR #4523 by Maria S: "redaction before otel init + retry clone fix"
Jay K.: also let's add a small note in onboarding doc about env vs header sources for req ids so new users don't hit this
Ingrid M.: thanks. I still think we should make default sampleapp use header injection (X-Request-Id) since that's closest to production
Maria S.: agreed
telemetry-bot: analytics.event recorded: "devex.telemetry.onboarding.issue" metadata={level:debug, leak:true}
Ingrid M.: I'll follow up with repro steps and a minimal repro gist
Jay K.: thx, please tag me
Ingrid M.: tagging @Maria S. for PR review and @Jay K. for runbook
Maria S.: working on it :thumbsup:
